quiz.nationality.label: Which passport will you apply with?
quiz.nationality.help: The route is mostly the same either way — the paperwork is not.
quiz.nationality.option.mercosur: A Mercosur country (Argentina, Brazil, Uruguay, Bolivia, Chile)
quiz.goal.label: What do you actually want out of this?
quiz.goal.help: Answer for the next two years, not the next twenty.
quiz.goal.option.relocate: To move to Paraguay and live there
quiz.goal.option.base: A legal base I keep, while I mostly live elsewhere
quiz.goal.option.invest: To invest, and get residency as part of that
quiz.timeline.label: How soon do you need the card in your hand?
quiz.timeline.help: Every route has a waiting period. Knowing yours changes the advice.
quiz.timeline.option.asap: As fast as it can be done
quiz.timeline.option.exploring: I am still working out whether to do this at all
quiz.capital.label: How much capital could you put into a qualifying investment?
quiz.capital.help: Bands only. We confirm the current thresholds on your call, never from a web page.
quiz.capital.option.under_50k: Not much — I would rather not invest to get residency
quiz.capital.option.band_50k_150k: A moderate amount, if the case for it is clear
quiz.family.label: Who is coming with you?
quiz.family.help: Dependants change the documents, the cost and the timeline.
quiz.family.option.family: Partner and children, or other dependants
quiz.tax.label: Is tax residency part of the reason?
quiz.tax.help: An honest answer here changes which route we recommend.
quiz.tax.option.yes: Yes, that is a large part of it
quiz.tax.option.no: No, it is about living there
quiz.tax.option.unsure: I do not know enough yet to say
quiz.result.noAnswers: We could not read any answers from that link, so this is the standard starting point. Take the two minutes and answer properly — the advice changes.
quiz.result.sibling: That route is handled by {brand}, our sister brand. Same team, separate site.
quiz.result.formBody: Send it over and a person will tell you whether this route is right for your case — including when the answer is that you should wait.
quiz.result.temporary.title: Start with temporary residency
quiz.result.temporary.body: The standard first step, and the right one for most people. You apply once, live with the card, and convert to permanent when the qualifying period is up.
quiz.result.permanent.title: Aim straight at permanent residency
quiz.result.permanent.body: Your answers point at the long-validity card rather than the two-step path. There are presence rules attached, and they are the part people get wrong, so we go through them with you before anything is filed.
quiz.result.investor-pass.title: Look at the Investor Pass
quiz.result.investor-pass.body: With capital to deploy and a short timeline, the Investor Pass is worth pricing out: it grants permanent residency without the temporary stage. It is a new programme and the rules are still moving, so nothing is quoted until we have checked the current text.
